seo.titulo: Tag people on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook | Clipfine
seo.descripcion: Mention the cast and guests with @ once and each network gets their username. Verified accounts, suggestions from what's said in the clip, and Instagram and Facebook collaborators.

bajada: Add the cast and guests with their username on each network. When you publish, type @Ana and Clipfine puts the right username on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Facebook, and warns you if an account doesn't exist.

d1.que: that comes out right on all four networks

d2.que: cast, Global and each episode's guests

agencia.menciones: Nobody has to remember every guest's username on every network.
agencia.tresNiveles: A returning guest isn't added twice, and the cast is always at hand.
agencia.verificar: A misspelled username never gets published: you see it first.
agencia.sugeridas: You don't miss tagging someone who's named in the clip.
agencia.colaboradores: The guest or sponsor shares the Reel on their profile without you asking.
agencia.buscar: Find anyone from any client in seconds.

colaboradores.pie: If they accept, the Reel also shows on their profile

p1.p: Are the tags real on every network?
p1.r: On Instagram, yes: the person is tagged on the Reel and also mentioned in the text. TikTok, YouTube and Facebook don't let outside apps tag people, so there it goes out as an @mention in the description, with their username on that network.

p2.p: How do I know the username is spelled right?
p2.r: Clipfine looks it up on the network when you add it. TikTok and YouTube confirm whether it exists; Instagram, if it's a professional account; Facebook, if it's a Page Meta lets us see. When the network doesn't allow checking, you get the profile link to look at it.

p3.p: What about a guest who comes only once?
p3.r: Add them to the episode and they stay there. If they come back, move them to Global in one tap and they're ready for any clip, without adding them again.

p4.p: Can I invite them as a collaborator?
p4.r: Yes. On Instagram, up to 3 accounts per Reel; on Facebook, up to 10 Pages (not personal profiles). They get the invitation and, if they accept, the Reel also shows on their profile or Page.
